commands.hearth.destroyEmptyBottles.true: Empty bottles will now be destroyed
commands.hearth.destroyEmptyBottles.fals: Empty bottles will now be kept
commands.hearth.help:
§6===== /hearth Command Help =====
§e/hearth potionAffectEntity include|in|+ <entity> §7- Add entity to affected list
§e/hearth potionAffectEntity exclude|ex|- <entity> §7- Remove entity from affected list
§e/hearth potionStack true|false|<1-64> §7- Set max potion stack size (true=64, false=1)
§e/hearth byproduct <item> <1-64> §7- Set furnace byproduct item & count
§e/hearth destroyEmptyBottles true|false §7- Toggle empty bottle destruction
§e/hearth reload §7- Reload configuration from file
§e/hearth saveDefault §7- Save current config to file
§e/hearth help §7- Show this help
